scope: B201, R-CILQR spatial reference, nominal initial pose, LTV-MPC tracking with dynamic obstacles at actual simulation time
purpose: Engineering acceptance targets fixed before evaluating final tracking, not universal safety guarantees or a literature standard.
reference_policy: Keep the original spatial reference and terminal point. Any speed/time reparameterization must be recorded and described, without resetting the reference to measured vehicle state.
timing_policy: Report all controller computation times and deadline exceedances. A no-delay offline simulation is not evidence of real-time execution when computation exceeds the control period.
